claims.claim: The proposal requests 1,162,746 ada, consisting of 1,128,880 ada for Plutarch and Ply maintenance, compatibility, and developer experience plus a 33,866 ada Intersect budget administration fee.

Plutarch is described as a Haskell eDSL for creating efficient Cardano smart contracts via controlled compilation into UPLC, and Ply is described as tooling for serializing Plutarch scripts to and from CIP-57 blueprint-style artifacts with inferred types.

MLabs says Plutarch and Ply maintenance will prioritize critical breakages and vulnerabilities, protocol-era and hard-fork compatibility, bug fixes and optimizations, and documentation or developer-experience improvements in that order.

MLabs states that a recent internal audit counted at least 26 teams building with Plutarch and Ply in the motivation section, while the rationale section says it conservatively counted at least 15 teams.

The proposal claims Plutarch scripts rank among the smallest in MLabs' public cross-language benchmark suite while requiring comparatively low on-chain compute and memory, with a benchmark URL supplied.

The proposal says it achieved the required 67% support threshold during the 2026 Intersect Budget Process Hydra Voting phase and was advanced for on-chain Treasury Withdrawal submission under the approved Budget Process Framework.
The proposal asserts the requested amount did not, at submission, breach the applicable 350M ada Net Change Limit for Epoch 613 to Epoch 713, either alone or in aggregate.
The proposal states independent oversight will be provided through Intersect and technically capable third parties, with reporting obligations and milestone-based disbursement controls.
The document discloses prior MLabs funding from listed treasury actions, Project Catalyst awards, and a prior 70,000 ada Intersect payment to update Plutarch for Conway-era features.

The proposal states treasury funds will be managed through Sundae Labs treasury management smart contracts with specified TRSC and PSSC addresses, external oversight committee members, threshold permissions, and a public dashboard for auditability.

summary: The document requests 1,162,746 ada for one annual maintenance and enhancement work package covering Plutarch and Ply, with governance process references, NCL compliance assertions, prior-funding disclosures, and smart-contract-based treasury administration details.
